page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor. It features 28 dedicated vCPUs across 14 physical cores with hyper-threading, running at a base speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 112 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are delivered by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. Local storage is provided via a 472 GB SSD, and network connectivity is anchored by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between CPU and GPU performance profiles. Single-core CPU performance is poor, placing in the bottom 10% on stress-ng tests, and single-threaded gzip compression is weak. However, multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput register in the average range. Notably, the GPU-accelerated architecture excels in LLM inference, achieving top-tier results for prompt processing on 135M and 7B models, as well as text generation on 7B models.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its reliance on older Intel Broadwell CPU architecture and NVIDIA Pascal GPU technology, which limits single-core execution speeds but offers a highly cost-effective entry point for parallel computing. It is well-suited for workloads such as medium-scale deep learning inference, parallel data processing, and GPU-accelerated database operations where multi-threaded throughput and VRAM capacity are prioritized over raw single-core CPU frequency.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It is equipped with 28 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor, 112 GB of RAM, a 472 GB local SSD, and a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. While single-core CPU performance is weak, the instance delivers average multi-core CPU and memory bandwidth performance. It excels in GPU-driven tasks, demonstrating top-tier performance in LLM inference prompt processing and text generation for medium-sized models. This hardware profile makes the instance a cost-effective choice for workloads such as deep learning inference, parallel data processing, and GPU-accelerated database operations where high-density parallel compute is required without the premium cost of newer GPU architectures.
